english.note: Use 收返 as the all-purpose choice when physically pulling something back or taking back something previously given or allowed.

exampleSentences.english: When a car comes too close, I immediately withdraw my foot.
exampleSentences.traditional: 架車埋到嚟，我就即刻收返隻腳。
exampleSentences.jyutping: gaa3 ce1 maai4 dou3 lai4 ngo5 zau6 zik1 hak1 sau1 faan1 zek3 goek3

english.note: Use this when withdrawing words or taking back an order in ordinary speech.

exampleSentences.english: I recall what I just said.
exampleSentences.jyutping: ngo5 sau1 faan1 tau4 sin1 go2 geoi3 syut3 waa6
